home.title: Medical cases that need your support
home.subtitle: Every case is vetted by the welfare board and an approved doctor. The platform never holds money: pledge, transfer, upload the receipt, and we verify it.
home.heroTitle: Treatment for those who need it, with donations you can follow
home.heroBody: We publish vetted medical cases, verify every donation and pay the hospital directly. The figures shown are money the council has actually verified.
home.casesSoon: Published cases will appear here soon.

steps.title: You pledge
steps.body: Pick a case and record the amount you will give.

steps.title: You transfer or hand in cash
steps.body: A bank transfer with the receipt uploaded, or cash at a nearby collection point.

steps.title: We verify
steps.body: The finance verifier matches the amount and issues an official receipt.

steps.title: We pay the hospital
steps.body: Payment goes only to the approved hospital, and the case shows as completed.
